_about: My labels (manual) for the blind sample of Phase 3's absence look 1 (eval/blind_solve_absence_look1.json, 30 trials, seed 11, drawn before the run). Written from the trials alone, before any judge verdict on them existed; never corrected after reading verdicts (a later disagreement is recorded beside the label, not by changing it). Conventions as in labels_phase1/absence_box.json. mechanism: skipped-check (the condition is never checked or mentioned), misread (a wrong value is stated or two fields are conflated), saw-mismatch-accepted (the mismatch is stated and acted on anyway), - (not determined from the trial).
